text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kyodo News Hai, the first 
targeted race of the Classic Year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Receiving cheers from the rivals with whom 
she had deepened her friendship over the 
past six months, El Condor Pasa felt her 
motivation surging to the brim.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her quest to conquer the Japan Cup... 
begins right here!
